title: Booking a room
summary: Book a hotel room by phone, ask about prices, breakfast and payment, and use hollow verbs like زُرْتُ (I visited) and يَزُورُ (he visits).
intro: Yusuf wants to show his friends Petra, three hours south of Amman, so Layla phones a small hotel in Wadi Musa to book rooms. Listen for verbs with a long vowel in the middle, called 'hollow' verbs: زَارَ (he visited), يَزُورُ (he visits), قَالَ (he said), يَقُولُ (he says), كَانَ (he was). With I, you and we the long ā of the past becomes short: زُرْتُ (I visited), قُلْتُ (I said), كُنْتُ (I was).
objectives: Book a room by phone with أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَحْجِزَ…
Ask about the price, breakfast and paying by card or in cash
Use hollow verbs in the past and present: زُرْتُ, كُنْتُ, نَعُودُ, نَكُونُ
Say how many people and how many nights

realLife.title: A phone call to Wadi Musa
realLife.story: Wadi Musa is the small town at the gate of Petra, full of family hotels. Layla calls one of them on Friday morning, while Daniel listens and takes notes: two rooms for Saturday night, breakfast included, and a piece of advice from the receptionist about the best time to visit.

sentences.en: I'd like to book a room for two people.
sentences.literal: I want that I book a room for two persons

mistakes.why: After an the verb ends in -a: an aḥjiza.

sentences.literal: did you (all) visit Petra from before?

mistakes.why: Before an ending like -tum the long ā of zāra becomes a short u: zurtum.

sentences.literal: we did not visit it ever

mistakes.why: After lam the verb ends in a sukūn, so the long ū becomes short: lam nazurhā.

sentences.en: We're going back to Amman on Sunday.
sentences.literal: we return to Amman (on the) day (of) Sunday

sentences.en: I have been to Jordan once.
sentences.literal: I was in Jordan one time

sentences.en: The price for one night is fifty dinars.

dialogue.title: Two rooms for Saturday night
dialogue.culture: Jordan's money is the dinar, دِينَار, which is worth much more than the Egyptian pound; a dinar has a thousand fils. Petra is one of the most visited places in the Arab world, so it is wise to book a room in Wadi Musa before you travel, especially in spring and autumn.

lines.ar: يَا دَانْيَال، يُوسُف يَقُولُ: لَازِم أَنْ نَنَامَ لَيْلَة فِي وَادِي مُوسَى، قُرْبَ الْبَتْرَاء. أَتَّصِلُ الْآنَ بِفُنْدُق هُنَاكَ.
lines.en: Daniel, Yusuf says we must spend a night in Wadi Musa, near Petra. I'm calling a hotel there now.
segs: Wadi (valley): part of 'Wadi Musa', a town near Petra

lines.ar: فِكْرَة جَيِّدَة! الطَّرِيق مِنْ عَمَّان إِلَى الْبَتْرَاء طَوِيل: ثَلَاث سَاعَات بِالسَّيَّارَة تَقْرِيبًا.
lines.en: Good idea! The road from Amman to Petra is long: about three hours by car.

lines.ar: فُنْدُقُ الْوَادِي، صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر، مَعَكُمْ سَلْمَى. كَيْفَ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أُسَاعِدَكُمْ؟
lines.en: Valley Hotel, good morning, Salma speaking. How can I help you?

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور. أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَحْجِزَ غُرْفَتَيْنِ لِلَيْلَةِ السَّبْت، مِنْ فَضْلِكِ. هَلْ عِنْدَكُمْ غُرَف فَارِغَة؟
lines.en: Good morning. I'd like to book two rooms for Saturday night, please. Do you have any free rooms?

lines.ar: لَحْظَة، مِنْ فَضْلِكِ… نَعَم، عِنْدَنَا. كَمْ شَخْصًا أَنْتُمْ، وَكَمْ لَيْلَةً تُرِيدُونَ أَنْ تَبْقَوْا؟
lines.en: One moment, please… yes, we do. How many people are you, and how many nights do you want to stay?
segs: you stay (to several people, after an)

lines.ar: نَحْنُ ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْخَاص، وَنَكُونُ عِنْدَكُمْ لَيْلَة وَاحِدَة فَقَطْ. يَوْمَ الْأَحَد نَعُودُ إِلَى عَمَّان.
lines.en: There are three of us, and we'll be with you for just one night. On Sunday we're going back to Amman.
segs: and we are, and we will be
with you (lit. at you, to several people)

lines.ar: إِذَنْ غُرْفَة لِشَخْصَيْنِ وَغُرْفَة لِشَخْص وَاحِد. اللَّيْلَة بِخَمْسِينَ دِينَارًا لِلْغُرْفَة الْكَبِيرَة، وَبِثَلَاثِينَ لِلصَّغِيرَة.
lines.en: So one room for two people and one room for one person. A night is fifty dinars for the big room and thirty for the small one.

lines.ar: هَلِ الْفُطُور مَعَ الْغُرْفَة؟ وَهَلْ مِنَ الْمُمْكِن أَنْ نَدْفَعَ بِالْبِطَاقَة عِنْدَمَا نَصِلُ؟
lines.en: Is breakfast included with the room? And is it possible to pay by card when we arrive?

lines.ar: نَعَم، الْفُطُور مَعَ الْغُرْفَة، وَتَسْتَطِيعُونَ أَنْ تَدْفَعُوا بِالْبِطَاقَة أَوْ نَقْدًا. هَلْ زُرْتُمُ الْبَتْرَاء مِنْ قَبْلُ؟
lines.en: Yes, breakfast is included, and you can pay by card or in cash. Have you visited Petra before?
segs: you pay (to several people, after an)

lines.ar: لَا، أَنَا وَصَدِيقِي لَمْ نَزُرْهَا أَبَدًا. أَنَا كُنْتُ فِي الْأُرْدُنّ مَرَّة وَاحِدَة فَقَطْ، وَهُوَ يَزُورُ الْأُرْدُنّ لِأَوَّلِ مَرَّة.
lines.en: No, my friend and I have never visited it. I've only been to Jordan once, and he is visiting Jordan for the first time.

lines.ar: سَتُحِبُّونَهَا كَثِيرًا! نَصِيحَتِي: نَامُوا مُبَكِّرًا، وَزُورُوا الْبَتْرَاء فِي الصَّبَاح، قَبْلَ الشَّمْس وَالسُّيَّاح.
lines.en: You'll love it! My advice: go to bed early, and visit Petra in the morning, before the sun and the tourists.
segs: you will love it (to several people)
sleep! go to bed! (to a group)

lines.ar: شُكْرًا عَلَى النَّصِيحَة! كَيْفَ أُؤَكِّدُ الْحَجْز؟ هَلْ تُرِيدِينَ اسْمِي وَرَقْمَ هَاتِفِي؟
lines.en: Thanks for the advice! How do I confirm the booking? Do you want my name and my phone number?

lines.ar: نَعَم، مِنْ فَضْلِكِ. وَأَرْجُو أَنْ تَقُولِي لِي أَيْضًا فِي أَيِّ سَاعَة تَصِلُونَ تَقْرِيبًا.
lines.en: Yes, please. And please also tell me roughly what time you will arrive.
segs: you say, you tell (to a woman, after an)

lines.ar: اِسْمِي لَيْلَى، وَرَقْمِي صِفْر سَبْعَة تِسْعَة… وَنَصِلُ يَوْمَ السَّبْت فِي السَّاعَة الرَّابِعَة بَعْدَ الظُّهْر تَقْرِيبًا.
lines.en: My name is Layla, and my number is zero seven nine… And we'll arrive on Saturday at about four in the afternoon.

lines.ar: شُكْرًا يَا لَيْلَى، الْحَجْز جَاهِز: غُرْفَتَانِ لِلَيْلَةِ السَّبْت. نَرَاكُمْ يَوْمَ السَّبْت، وَرِحْلَة سَعِيدَة!
lines.en: Thank you, Layla, the booking is done: two rooms for Saturday night. See you on Saturday, and have a good trip!

lines.ar: أَحْسَنْتِ يَا لَيْلَى! كُلُّ شَيْء جَاهِز. وَالْآنَ نَقُولُ لِيُوسُف: يَوْمَ السَّبْت نَحْنُ فِي الْبَتْرَاء!
lines.en: Well done, Layla! Everything is ready. And now let's tell Yusuf: on Saturday we'll be in Petra!

reading.title: A room near Petra
reading.ar: اِتَّصَلَتْ لَيْلَى بِفُنْدُق فِي وَادِي مُوسَى، قُرْبَ الْبَتْرَاء. حَجَزَتْ غُرْفَتَيْنِ لِلَيْلَةِ السَّبْت: غُرْفَة لِشَخْصَيْنِ وَغُرْفَة لِشَخْص وَاحِد. الْفُطُور مَعَ الْغُرْفَة، وَالْأَصْدِقَاء يَدْفَعُونَ بِالْبِطَاقَة عِنْدَمَا يَصِلُونَ. يَوْمَ الْأَحَد يَعُودُونَ إِلَى عَمَّان.
reading.en: Layla called a hotel in Wadi Musa, near Petra. She booked two rooms for Saturday night: one room for two people and one room for one person. Breakfast is included, and the friends will pay by card when they arrive. On Sunday they go back to Amman.
segs: Wadi (valley): part of 'Wadi Musa', a town near Petra

completion: Well done! You can book a room by phone, ask about prices and payment, and use hollow verbs like زُرْتُ and يَزُورُ. Next time: asking for help.
